en.t: This poem could at least help dispel her sorrow.

units.source_text: 明石女御昔年离明石浦来京都，当天早晨拜别外祖父明石道人时的情景，

en.t: The scene from years before, when the Akashi Consort left Akashi Bay for the capital and took leave of her maternal grandfather, the Akashi Monk, that very morning,

units.source_text: 现在做梦也回想不起来，觉得十分遗憾。

en.t: could no longer be recalled now even in dreams, which she found deeply regrettable.
